name: Kaion, Giant
body:
GIANT KAION
CR 11

XP 12,800
N Huge magical beast
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +27

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 12, flat-footed 22 (–2 size, +4 Dex, +14 natural)
hp 147 (14d10+70)
Fort +14, Ref +13, Will +10
Defensive Abilities void adaptation; DR 5/adamantine; Resist cold 10

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 slams +19 (2d8+6 B)
Ranged sclerite +17 (3d8+6 plus entangled)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 25 ft.
Special Attacks polarity pulse (+21), sclerite shower (6d8 P plus entangled, DC 22)

STATISTICS

Str 22 (+6); Dex 19 (+4); Con 20 (+5); Int 2 (–4); Wis 18 (+4); Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +14; CMB +22; CMD 36 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Fly, Perception), Weapon Focus (sclerite, slam)
Skills Fly +14, Perception +27
SQ magnetic levitation

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Magnetic Levitation (Ex)

A giant kaion can fly in a vacuum. A giant kaion’s magnetic levitation is powerful enough that it can fly even when not near a planetary surface or metallic object. Furthermore, it can travel through the void of space at phenomenal speeds, roughly equal to a starship GTSG traveling at standard thruster speeds.

Polarity Pulse (Ex)

See above.

Sclerites (Ex)

See above; DC 22.

Sclerite Shower (Ex)

Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a giant kaion can shoot a cluster of sclerites in a 30-foot cone or 60-foot line burst. Creatures in the area take 6d6 piercing damage and are entangled by the giant kaion’s sclerites. An affected creature can attempt a DC 22 Reflex save to take half damage and ignore the entangled effect. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Void Adaptation (Ex)

See above.

ECOLOGY

Environment mountains, urban, or vacuum
Organization solitary, pair, or pod (3–6)
Treasure none
